ei.title: 1번: The CIA's Failed Spy Cat Project
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such stubborn animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was abandoned.

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are (A)[beloved / disliked] by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite (B)[difficult / easy] because they are such stubborn animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was (C)[adopted / abandoned].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) beloved=사랑받는 / disliked=미움받는 (B) difficult=어려운 / easy=쉬운 (C) abandoned=포기된 / adopted=채택된
det.analysis:
① beloved—difficult—abandoned: 고양이는 사람들에게 사랑받고(beloved), 훈련은 어려웠으며(difficult), 결국 아이디어는 포기되었다(abandoned) ←정답
② disliked: 고양이가 '미움받는다'는 문맥과 반대
③ easy/adopted: 훈련이 '쉬웠다'/아이디어가 '채택되었다'는 실패 결말과 반대
④ 세 자리 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 고양이는 사랑받고(beloved) → 훈련은 어렵고(difficult) → 결국 포기됨(abandoned)의 흐름

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would (A)[trust / suspect] a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such (B)[stubborn / obedient] animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this (C)[successful / unsuccessful] experiment, the idea of using cats was abandoned.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) suspect=의심하다 / trust=신뢰하다 (B) stubborn=고집이 센 / obedient=순종적인 (C) unsuccessful=실패한 / successful=성공한
det.analysis:
① trust: 아무도 고양이를 '신뢰하지' 않을 것? 의심(suspect)하지 않을 것이라는 문맥과 반대
② obedient: 고양이가 '순종적'이라 훈련이 어려웠다? 앞뒤 모순
③ suspect—stubborn—unsuccessful: 아무도 의심하지 않고, 고집이 세서 훈련이 어렵고, 실패한 실험 ←정답
④ 세 자리 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 아무도 의심 안 함(suspect) → 고집셈(stubborn) → 실패한(unsuccessful) 실험

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make (A)[useless / perfect] spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such stubborn animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA (B)[concluded / doubted] their animal agent was (C)[ready / unprepared]. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was abandoned.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) perfect=완벽한 / useless=쓸모없는 (B) concluded=결론지었다 / doubted=의심했다 (C) ready=준비된 / unprepared=준비되지 않은
det.analysis:
① useless: 고양이가 '쓸모없는' 스파이가 될 것? CIA가 완벽한(perfect) 스파이로 여긴 문맥과 반대
② perfect—concluded—ready: 완벽한 스파이가 되고, CIA가 준비됐다고 결론짓고, 요원이 준비된 상태 ←정답
③ doubted/unprepared: '의심했다'/'준비 안 됨'은 훈련 완료 후 파견한 흐름과 반대
④ 세 자리 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 완벽한(perfect) 스파이 → 5년 훈련 후 결론지음(concluded) → 준비됨(ready)

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are ①<u>beloved</u> by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make ②<u>perfect</u> spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite ③<u>easy</u> because they are such stubborn animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was ④<u>abandoned</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① beloved=사랑받는 ② perfect=완벽한 ③ easy→difficult(부적절) ④ abandoned=포기된
det.analysis:
① beloved: 고양이는 사람들에게 사랑받는다 — 적절
② perfect: 완벽한 스파이가 될 것이라 여김 — 적절
③ easy: 훈련이 '쉬웠다'? 바로 뒤 '고집이 센 동물이라서(such stubborn animals)'와 모순 → difficult(어려운)가 원문 ←정답
④ abandoned: 실패로 아이디어를 포기함 — 적절
det.tip: 'because they are such stubborn animals(고집이 세서)'가 단서 → 훈련은 difficult(어려웠다)

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would ①<u>suspect</u> a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors ②<u>surgically</u> placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such ③<u>stubborn</u> animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this ④<u>successful</u> experiment, the idea of using cats was abandoned.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① suspect=의심하다 ② surgically=수술로 ③ stubborn=고집이 센 ④ successful→unsuccessful(부적절)
det.analysis:
① suspect: 아무도 고양이를 의심하지 않을 것 — 적절
② surgically: 의사들이 수술로 송신기를 심음 — 적절
③ stubborn: 고집이 센 동물이라 훈련이 어려움 — 적절
④ successful: '성공한' 실험의 결과로 아이디어를 포기했다? 포기(abandoned)는 실패를 뜻함 → unsuccessful(실패한)이 원문 ←정답
det.tip: 아이디어를 abandoned(포기)한 결과 → 실험은 unsuccessful(실패한). successful은 정반대

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the ①<u>government</u>. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such ②<u>friendly</u> animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a ③<u>conversation</u> between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was ④<u>abandoned</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① government=정부 ② friendly→stubborn(부적절) ③ conversation=대화 ④ abandoned=포기된
det.analysis:
① government: 정부를 위해 일한다고 의심 — 적절
② friendly: '다정한(friendly)' 동물이라 훈련이 어려웠다? 다정하면 훈련이 쉬워야 하므로 모순 → stubborn(고집이 센)이 원문 ←정답
③ conversation: 두 남자 사이의 대화를 녹음 — 적절
④ abandoned: 아이디어를 포기함 — 적절
det.tip: 훈련이 quite difficult(어려운) 이유 → friendly(다정)가 아니라 stubborn(고집셈)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: spies=스파이, 첩보원 / pets=애완동물 / doctors=의사 / taxis=택시
det.analysis:
① spies: CIA가 고양이를 완벽한 '스파이'로 만들 수 있다고 결정 — 뒤 문장의 '정부를 위해 일하는 것을 의심'과 연결 ←정답
② pets: 애완동물을 '만든다'는 문맥 부적절
③ doctors: 의사는 뒤 문장에서 수술을 하는 주체일 뿐
④ taxis: 택시는 마지막에 고양이를 친 대상
det.tip: CIA + working for the government(정부를 위해 일함)이 단서 → 첩보원(spies)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: microphone=마이크 / antenna=안테나 / camera=카메라 / transmitter=송신기
det.analysis:
① microphone: 마이크는 '귀(ear)'에 넣음
② antenna: 안테나는 '척추(backbone)'를 따라 설치
③ camera: 본문에 등장하지 않는 장치
④ transmitter: '가슴(chest)'에 넣은 작은 장치 = 송신기 ←정답
det.tip: in her chest(가슴에) + tiny(작은) + 신호를 보내는 장치 → transmitter(송신기)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: training=훈련 / operation=수술 / conversation=대화 / experiment=실험
det.analysis:
① training: 훈련은 '어려웠다(difficult)'고 뒤에서 대조됨
② operation: 앞에서 의사가 수술로 장치를 심었으므로, 그 '수술'을 수행하는 것은 어렵지 않았다 ←정답
③ conversation: 대화는 고양이가 녹음할 대상
④ experiment: 실험은 전체 프로젝트를 가리킴
det.tip: 앞 문장 surgically placed(수술로 심음) → Performing the ____(수술) was not that hard

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 beloved와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: beloved=사랑받는 / feared=두려움의 대상인 / ignored=무시받는 / adored=사랑받는, 흠모받는 / abandoned=버려진
det.analysis:
① feared: 두려움의 대상 — 의미 다름
② ignored: 무시받는 — 의미 다름
③ adored: 흠모받는, 매우 사랑받는 — beloved의 동의어 ←정답
④ abandoned: 버려진 — beloved와 반대
det.tip: beloved(사랑받는)와 가장 가까운 뜻 = adored(흠모받는)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 stubborn과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: stubborn=고집이 센 / inflexible=완고한, 융통성 없는 / clever=영리한 / gentle=온순한 / tired=피곤한
det.analysis:
① inflexible: 완고한, 자기 뜻을 굽히지 않는 — stubborn의 동의어 ←정답
② clever: 영리한 — 의미 다름
③ gentle: 온순한 — stubborn과 반대
④ tired: 피곤한 — 의미 다름
det.tip: stubborn(고집이 센)과 가까운 뜻 = inflexible(완고한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 abandoned와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: abandoned=포기된, 버려진 / continued=계속된 / improved=개선된 / recorded=기록된 / dropped=버려진, 폐기된

det.tip: abandoned an idea(아이디어를 포기하다) = dropped an idea(폐기하다)

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 chest의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

② (A) 상자 (B) 가슴: 고양이 몸속 '상자'? 부적절
③ (A) 가슴 (B) 서랍: 나무 서랍을 파냈다? 부적절
④ (A) 상자 (B) 서랍: 둘 다 부적절
det.tip: chest는 다의어: 신체 '가슴' vs 보관용 '상자/궤'

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to give up something completely or stop doing it"

det.korean: conclude=결론짓다 / suspect=의심하다 / perform=수행하다 / abandon=포기하다, 버리다
det.analysis:
① conclude: 결론짓다 — 정의와 다름
② suspect: 의심하다 — 정의와 다름
③ perform: 수행하다 — 정의와 다름
④ abandon: 어떤 것을 완전히 포기하거나 그만두다 = 정의와 일치 ←정답
det.tip: give up completely(완전히 포기하다) = abandon(포기하다)

questions.passage: It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of __________ (work) for the government.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: work(동사: 일하다) → working(동명사). 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사가 온다
det.analysis: 전치사 of 다음에는 명사나 동명사가 와야 하므로 work를 working으로 바꾼다. 'suspect A of -ing'은 'A가 ~한다고 의심하다'라는 표현이다
det.tip: 전치사(of) 뒤 → 동명사(-ing). suspect ~ of working

questions.passage: Sadly, the cat was __________ (hit) by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: hit(동사: 치다) → hit(과거분사). 수동태 be+p.p. 구문이며, hit는 hit-hit-hit로 형태가 변하지 않는 불규칙 동사
det.analysis: 고양이가 택시에 '부딪힘을 당한' 것이므로 수동태(be + 과거분사)가 필요하다. hit는 원형·과거·과거분사가 모두 hit로 같은 불규칙 동사라 형태가 그대로다
det.tip: was ____ by(수동태) → 과거분사 필요. hit의 과거분사는 hit(형태 불변)

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the government. After choosing a __________, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such stubborn animals. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was abandoned.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: tiny transmitter=작은 송신기 / female cat=암컷 고양이 / passing taxi=지나가는 택시 / animal agent=동물 요원
det.analysis:
① tiny transmitter: 송신기는 고양이 가슴에 심은 장치
② female cat: '암컷 고양이를 고른 뒤(after choosing a ____)' 그녀(her)의 가슴에 장치를 심었다 → 뒤의 her가 암컷을 가리킴 ←정답
③ passing taxi: 택시는 마지막 사고 장면
④ animal agent: 동물 요원은 훈련 완료 후 표현
det.tip: 뒤 문장의 her(그녀의)가 단서 → female cat(암컷 고양이)을 고른 것

questions.passage: Clever and cute, cats are beloved by people around the world. That's why, in the 1960s, the CIA decided they would make perfect spies. It was believed that nobody would suspect a cat of working for the government. After choosing a female cat, doctors surgically placed a tiny transmitter in her chest, along with a microphone in her ear and an antenna running along her backbone. Performing the operation was not that hard. However, training the cat proved to be quite difficult because they are such __________. Finally, after five years of training, the CIA concluded their animal agent was ready. So, they sent her to record a conversation between two men from the Soviet Union. Sadly, the cat was hit by a passing taxi after taking only a few steps. As a result of this unsuccessful experiment, the idea of using cats was abandoned.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: clever animals=영리한 동물 / perfect spies=완벽한 스파이 / trained agents=훈련된 요원 / stubborn animals=고집이 센 동물
det.analysis:
① clever animals: 영리하면 오히려 훈련이 쉬워야 함
② perfect spies: 완벽한 스파이는 훈련이 어려운 이유가 될 수 없음
③ trained agents: 이미 훈련된 요원이면 훈련이 어렵다는 문맥과 모순
④ stubborn animals: 훈련이 어려웠던(difficult) 이유 = 고양이가 고집이 센 동물이기 때문 ←정답
det.tip: training ~ difficult because they are such ____ → 부정적 특성 = stubborn animals(고집셈)
